error.sessionInUse.en: This session is already in use, possibly by another running DSH instance (such as dsh web or the desktop app). Quit other running DSH instances and try again.
error.sessionInUse.zh: 当前会话已被占用，可能是其他正在运行的 DSH 导致的（如其他 dsh web、桌面端），请退出其他正在运行的 DSH 后重试。

changes.openReview.en: Review this turn’s changes in the sidebar
changes.openReview.zh: 在侧边栏查看本轮改动

changes.expandAria.zh: 展开全部 {count} 个改动文件

review.openFile.en: Open the whole file in the sidebar
review.openFile.zh: 在侧边栏打开整个文件

diff.missing.en: The contents of this turn’s changes are no longer available
diff.missing.zh: 这轮改动的内容已不可用

diff.binary.en: Binary file; changes cannot be shown
diff.binary.zh: 二进制文件，无法显示改动

diff.oversized.en: File too large; changes cannot be shown
diff.oversized.zh: 文件过大，无法显示改动

diff.unchanged.en: Both sides hold the same lines

diff.coarse.en: Line comparison timed out; shown as a whole-file replacement
diff.coarse.zh: 逐行对比超时，按整个文件替换显示

diff.openNativeError.en: Could not open. Click to retry.

error.sessionInUse.en: This session is already in use, possibly by another running DSH instance (such as dsh web or the desktop app). Quit other running DSH instances and try again.
error.sessionInUse.zh: 当前会话已被占用，可能是其他正在运行的 DSH 导致的（如其他 dsh web、桌面端），请退出其他正在运行的 DSH 后重试。

preview.expired.en: This temporary plan preview has expired. Reopen it from the pending review card.
preview.expired.zh: 临时计划预览已失效，请从仍在等待审批的卡片重新打开。

unavailable.en: This deployment runs without a manageable profile, so plugins cannot be installed or switched here.
unavailable.zh: 本部署没有可管理的 profile，无法安装或启停插件。

restartNotice.en: The change takes effect at the next start
restartNotice.zh: 更改将在下次启动生效

overriddenNotice.en: {name} was saved, but a higher-priority configuration overrides it, so it is not in effect
overriddenNotice.zh: {name} 已保存，但被更高优先级的配置覆盖，当前未生效

builtinAgentTeamDescription.en: Enable agent team collaboration and team tools.
builtinAgentTeamDescription.zh: 启用智能体团队协作与团队工具。

builtinAgentTeamWebTitle.zh: 智能体团队 Web 界面

builtinAgentTeamWebDescription.en: View team members, the task board, and teammate sessions in the browser.
builtinAgentTeamWebDescription.zh: 在浏览器中查看团队成员、任务看板和成员会话。

builtinAutoReviewDescription.en: Add an Auto review permission mode that uses the model to assess authorization before each tool call.
builtinAutoReviewDescription.zh: 提供自动审查权限模式，由模型在每次工具调用前判断是否授权。

partsEmpty.en: This plugin pack contains no components.
partsEmpty.zh: 这个插件包不包含任何组件。

installDescription.en: Enter the plugin's package name, GitHub repository address, or local directory path.
installDescription.zh: 输入插件的包名、GitHub 仓库地址或本地目录路径。

installGuideIntro.en: Copy any one of these from the plugin's README or release page.
installGuideIntro.zh: 从插件的 README 或发布页面复制以下任意一项。

installGuideIdNote.en: The package name is the npm package name, usually dsh-xxx or @author/plugin; the display name is not one.
installGuideIdNote.zh: 包名即 npm 包名，常见形式为 dsh-xxx 或 @作者/插件名；插件的显示名称不是包名。

installGuideIdHint.en: The part after dsh plugin add or pnpm add in the README's install command.
installGuideIdHint.zh: README 安装命令中 dsh plugin add 或 pnpm add 之后的部分。

installGuideGitHint.en: The address of the plugin's open-source repository on GitHub; other Git hosts work too.
installGuideGitHint.zh: 插件在 GitHub 上的开源仓库地址，也支持其他 Git 仓库。

installGuidePathHint.en: The absolute path of a plugin directory on this machine, developed here or downloaded.
installGuidePathHint.zh: 本机上插件目录的绝对路径，适用于自行开发或已下载的插件。

installGuideSafety.en: Install only plugins you trust: they run with your permissions and can damage DeepSeek Harness or leak your data.
installGuideSafety.zh: 请确认插件来源可信。插件在本机以你的权限运行，来源不明的插件可能损坏 DeepSeek Harness，或读取和泄露你的数据。

installProblemInvalid.en: This is not a package name or address that can be installed: {reason}
installProblemInvalid.zh: 无法识别这个包名或地址：{reason}

installProblemNotPackage.en: The path does not exist or is not a valid plugin package
installProblemNotPackage.zh: 该路径不存在或不是有效的插件包

installProblemNotBundle.en: This package declares no bundle, so it cannot be installed as a plugin: {reason}
installProblemNotBundle.zh: 这个包没有声明组合包，无法作为插件安装：{reason}

installProblemNetwork.en: The plugin registry could not be reached; check the network and try again
installProblemNetwork.zh: 无法连接插件源，请检查网络后重试

installProblemUnknown.en: The plugin could not be looked up: {reason}

installFailedTitle.en: The plugin could not be installed

installCancelled.en: Installation cancelled; the plugin is not enabled, and downloaded files may remain
installCancelled.zh: 已取消安装，插件未启用，下载的文件可能保留

installCancelUnconfirmed.en: Installation has not been confirmed stopped. Retry cancellation or wait for the installation result. {reason}
installCancelUnconfirmed.zh: 尚未确认安装已停止，请重试取消或等待安装结果。{reason}

installFailureDiskFull.en: The disk is full; the install stopped
installFailureDiskFull.zh: 磁盘空间不足，安装已停止

installFailurePermission.en: No write permission; the plugin cannot be installed
installFailurePermission.zh: 没有写入权限，无法安装

installFailureBuildBlocked.en: A dependency's install scripts need your permission before the install can continue
installFailureBuildBlocked.zh: 有依赖的安装脚本需要你允许后才能继续

installFailureBuildBlockedManual.en: pnpm blocked install scripts; allow them under allowBuilds in pnpm-workspace.yaml and retry
installFailureBuildBlockedManual.zh: 有依赖的安装脚本被 pnpm 拦下，请在 profile 的 pnpm-workspace.yaml 的 allowBuilds 中放行后重试

installFailureIntegrity.en: The downloaded package failed its integrity check
installFailureIntegrity.zh: 下载的安装包校验失败

installFailurePnpmMissing.en: pnpm was not found, so nothing can be installed
installFailurePnpmMissing.zh: 没有找到 pnpm，无法安装

installFailureGeneric.en: Something went wrong during the install; the details say what
installFailureGeneric.zh: 安装过程中出错，原因见安装详情

installDoneNothing.en: Install finished with no new dependency.
installDoneNothing.zh: 安装完成，没有新增依赖。

installDoneRestart.en: Installed; it loads at the next start.
installDoneRestart.zh: 已安装，下次启动后加载。

installApprovalDescription.en: These packages have install scripts that pnpm did not run.
installApprovalDescription.zh: 以下包声明了安装脚本，pnpm 默认不运行。

installApprovalConsequence.en: Once allowed, the scripts run here with your permissions, and the permission is saved in this profile.
installApprovalConsequence.zh: 允许后，脚本会以你的权限在本机运行，授权保存在当前 profile，之后不再询问。

installApprovalCaution.zh: 只在信任这些包时允许。

confirmUninstallDescription.en: What it provides goes away once it is uninstalled.
confirmUninstallDescription.zh: 卸载后它提供的功能会消失。

reasonManagementRequired.en: Plugin management needs it; it cannot be switched off or uninstalled.
reasonManagementRequired.zh: 插件管理所需，不能停用或卸载

reasonUnaddressable.en: The profile patch cannot address this one uniquely.
reasonUnaddressable.zh: 当前 profile 的 patch 无法唯一定位这一项

reasonInvalidSpec.en: Enter a valid package name or address.
reasonInvalidSpec.zh: 请输入有效的包名或地址

reasonAmbiguousInstall.en: Which package was installed cannot be told from the dependency change.
reasonAmbiguousInstall.zh: 无法从依赖变更中确定安装了哪一个包

reasonNotBundle.en: This package declares no bundle, so it cannot be managed as a plugin.
reasonNotBundle.zh: 这个包没有声明组合包，不能作为插件管理

reasonNotRemovable.en: This package is not owned by the profile, or plugin management needs it.
reasonNotRemovable.zh: 这个包不属于当前 profile，或者是插件管理所需的组件

reasonStopProfile.en: This profile runs without HMR; stop it and uninstall the package with dsh plugin.
reasonStopProfile.zh: 这个 profile 没有启用 HMR，正在使用的包要停止后用 dsh plugin 卸载

reasonBundleInUse.en: Other configuration still uses this bundle's components; switch them off first.
reasonBundleInUse.zh: 其他配置仍在使用这个组合包的组件，请先停用它们

reasonStaleApproval.en: The pending script approvals changed; install again to refresh them.
reasonStaleApproval.zh: 待允许的安装脚本列表已变化，请重新安装以刷新

desktop.update.downloadDetail.zh:
正在下载更新：{percent}%
目标版本：V{version}

desktop.update.checkFailed.en: Could not check for updates. Please try again later.
desktop.update.checkFailed.zh: 检查更新失败，请稍后重试。

desktop.update.downloadFailed.en: Could not download the update. Please try again.

desktop.update.installFailed.en: Could not install the update. Please try again later.
desktop.update.installFailed.zh: 安装更新失败，请稍后重试。

desktop.update.checkNetworkFailed.en: Could not check for updates. Please try again later. The connection was interrupted. Check your network and try again.
desktop.update.checkNetworkFailed.zh: 检查更新失败，请稍后重试。网络连接异常，请检查网络后重试。

desktop.update.downloadNetworkFailed.en: Could not download the update. Please try again. The connection was interrupted. Check your network and try again.
desktop.update.downloadNetworkFailed.zh: 下载更新失败，请重试。网络连接异常，请检查网络后重试。

desktop.update.installNetworkFailed.en: Could not install the update. Please try again later. The connection was interrupted. Check your network and try again.
desktop.update.installNetworkFailed.zh: 安装更新失败，请稍后重试。网络连接异常，请检查网络后重试。

desktop.update.stopFailed.en: Tasks could not be stopped safely. The update was not installed. Please try again later.
desktop.update.stopFailed.zh: 未能安全停止任务，更新未安装。请稍后重试。

desktop.update.tasksChanged.en: New tasks started. Review the update confirmation again.
desktop.update.tasksChanged.zh: 有新任务开始，请重新确认更新。

desktop.update.tasksUnavailable.en: Task status is unavailable. Try updating again when the workspace is ready.
desktop.update.tasksUnavailable.zh: 无法确认任务状态，请在工作区就绪后重试更新。

clientSyncing.zh: 正在同步本页面的插件…

clientSyncFailed.en: Some plugins could not sync on this page. Host enablement is unchanged.
clientSyncFailed.zh: 本页面的插件未能完成同步；服务端的启用状态保持不变。

unavailable.en: This plugin is not loaded, so it cannot be configured right now.
unavailable.zh: 该插件当前未加载，暂时无法配置。

subagentDescription.en: Set Subagent recursion depth, count, and models.
subagentDescription.zh: 设置 Subagent 的递归层级、数量和模型。

subagentDepthHelp.en: Limits how many levels of Subagents an Agent can create.
subagentDepthHelp.zh: 限制 Agent 创建 Subagent 的递归层级。

subagentDepthOne.en: Only the main Agent can create Subagents
subagentDepthOne.zh: 仅允许主 Agent 创建 Subagent

subagentDepthOverride.en: If a tool defines its own maximum recursion depth, that setting takes precedence.
subagentDepthOverride.zh: 如果某个工具单独设置了最大递归深度，以该工具的设置为准。

subagentCapacityHelpLabel.zh: Subagent 并行数量上限说明

subagentCapacityHelp.en: Total live Subagents under the same main Agent, across all recursion levels. The main Agent is excluded. New start requests are rejected when the limit is reached.
subagentCapacityHelp.zh: 同一主 Agent 下，所有递归层级同时存活的 Subagent 总数，主 Agent 不计入。达到上限时，新的启动请求会被拒绝。

subagentDepthInvalid.en: Enter a whole number of 0 or more.
subagentDepthInvalid.zh: 请输入不小于 0 的整数。

subagentCapacityInvalid.en: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
subagentCapacityInvalid.zh: 请输入不小于 1 的整数。

sandbox.warning.en: Sandbox restrictions are disabled; the page can navigate the top-level app and use downloads, modal dialogs, and input locks.
sandbox.warning.zh: 沙箱限制已关闭；页面可以导航顶层应用，并使用下载、模态对话框与输入锁定。

start.en: Enter an HTTP(S) address to start browsing
start.zh: 输入 HTTP(S) 地址开始浏览

error.invalid.en: That address is invalid or too long.

error.protocol.en: Only HTTP and HTTPS addresses are supported; use Document Preview for local files.
error.protocol.zh: 只支持 HTTP 和 HTTPS 地址；本地文件请使用文档预览。

error.credentials.en: Addresses cannot contain a username or password.
error.credentials.zh: 地址不能包含用户名或密码。

error.application-origin.en: The embedded browser cannot open the DSH application itself.
error.application-origin.zh: 不能在嵌入浏览器中打开 DSH 应用自身。

web.loadFailed.en: The page reported a load failure or may block embedding; try opening it in the system browser.
web.loadFailed.zh: 页面报告加载失败或可能禁止嵌入；可尝试在系统浏览器中打开。

web.unknown.en: The page navigated inside the iframe; Web mode cannot read its current URL.
web.unknown.zh: 页面已在 iframe 内跳转；Web 模式无法读取当前 URL。

missingFonts.en: Fonts used in this document are unavailable: {fonts}. Text and layout may differ.
missingFonts.zh: 缺少文档使用的字体：{fonts}，可能影响文字和排版。

missingFontsDescription.en: These fonts are unavailable for this preview. Text and layout may differ from the original document.
missingFontsDescription.zh: 本次预览无法使用以下字体，预览中的文字和排版可能与原文档不同。

unavailable.en: Office previews are unavailable. Enable the document preview service on the computer running DeepSeek Harness.
unavailable.zh: Office 预览不可用。请在运行 DeepSeek Harness 的主机上启用文档预览服务。

invalid.en: This Office file cannot be previewed. It may be damaged, password protected, or have the wrong extension.
invalid.zh: 无法预览此 Office 文件。文件可能已损坏、受密码保护，或与扩展名不符。

tooLarge.en: The Office file or converted PDF exceeds the preview size limit. Reduce the file size or adjust the preview configuration.
tooLarge.zh: Office 文件或转换后的 PDF 超过预览大小上限，请缩小文件或调整预览配置。

failed.en: Office conversion did not produce a usable PDF. Check the file and try again.
failed.zh: Office 转换失败，未生成可用的 PDF。请检查该文件后重试。

timeout.en: Office conversion timed out. Try again.

busy.en: Office preview is busy. Try again shortly.
busy.zh: Office 预览任务较多，请稍后重试。

changed.en: The file changed while being read. Reopen the preview.
changed.zh: 文件在读取时已更改，请重新打开预览。

blockers.zh: 依赖任务 id（逗号分隔）

conflict.en: Task state changed and was reloaded. Review it before retrying.
conflict.zh: 任务状态已变化，已重新加载；请检查后重试。

presetCordisDescription.en: Built for creating custom agent presets, with all Standard mode capabilities plus runtime inspection, persistent plugin management, and preset-authoring guidance.
presetCordisDescription.wasEn: Built for creating custom agent presets, with all Standard mode capabilities plus runtime inspection, plugin experiments, and preset-authoring guidance.
presetCordisDescription.currentIt: Pensata per creare preset di agenti personalizzati: offre tutte le capacità della modalità standard più l'ispezione a runtime, gli esperimenti con i Plugin e le linee guida per la creazione dei preset.

presented.unavailable.en: This Host has no desktop available to open files or folders in external apps. Files can still be previewed in the sidebar.
presented.unavailable.wasEn: This Host has no desktop available to open files or folders
presented.unavailable.currentIt: Questo Host non ha un desktop disponibile per aprire file o cartelle

intro.en: Inspect the plugins this deployment ships.
intro.wasEn: Configure and inspect the plugins installed in this deployment.
intro.currentIt: Configura e ispeziona i Plugin installati in questa distribuzione.

empty.en: This deployment exposes no plugin views.
empty.wasEn: This deployment exposes no plugin settings.
empty.currentIt: Questa distribuzione non espone impostazioni dei Plugin.

subagentModelSelectionToggle.en: Allow agents to choose models for Subagents
subagentModelSelectionToggle.wasEn: Allow agents to choose models for subagents
subagentModelSelectionToggle.currentIt: Consenti agli agenti di scegliere i modelli per i subagenti

subagentModelSelectionChoose.en: When enabled, agents can choose a provider, model, and reasoning effort for each Subagent from the authorized models below. Applies only to new sessions.
subagentModelSelectionChoose.wasEn: When enabled, agents can choose a provider, model, and reasoning effort for each subagent from the authorized models below. Applies only to new sessions.
subagentModelSelectionChoose.currentIt: Se attivo, gli agenti possono scegliere un provider, un modello e un livello di ragionamento per ogni subagente tra i modelli autorizzati riportati sotto. Si applica solo alle nuove sessioni.
